summary: Source 203.0.113.77 produced multiple failed password attempts for user demo, then an Accepted password login. This is suspicious (possible credential use) but not proof of compromise.

findings.statement: Six failed password attempts for demo from 203.0.113.77 preceded a successful password login from the same source.
Success after failures may indicate password guessing that eventually worked, or a legitimate user mistyping then succeeding.
Auth logs cannot show post-login activity; compromise is not confirmed.

recommendation: Verify whether the demo login was authorized (demo scenario or real user). If unexpected, rotate the demo password and consider a temporary IP block pending human approval.

root_cause.statement: Credential guessing may have succeeded after prior failures; compromise is not confirmed from auth logs alone.

remediation.text: Rotate the demo password if this login was unexpected.
Review sshd Match User password-auth exceptions.
Propose a temporary IP block for 203.0.113.77 (human approval required).
